model: Agilent Cary 5000 with separately staged legacy 0010079800 extension

sources.review: Manufacturer 1020 x 710 x 380 mm envelope, 91 kg instrument, LockDown accessory mount and product appearance; product and sample-handling photographs visually inspected.
Manufacturer photos, removable sample floor and LockDown mechanism, internal 110 mm and external 150 mm accessories.

Manufacturer-authored legacy 0010079800 manual: 154 x 212 x 170 mm extension interior, approximately 180 mm additional depth, separate base and removable/hinged cover, keyhole pins, 6 mm hose fittings. All five pages and hinge diagram visually inspected.

vendor_resource_search.result: Manufacturer dimensional/product resources and extension manual found; no model-specific downloadable vendor CAD located in these searches.

variant_resolution: The task selects the documented legacy extension to match the selected legacy internal DRA. The paper does not identify extension generation.
The 2021 flyer gives a different 154 x 150 x 640 mm assembled-compartment statement. It is retained as a source difference and is not substituted for the legacy extension component dimensions.
Instrument sliding lid, removable standard front wall and removable/hinged extension cover are distinct parts.
inferences: Housing profiles, sample-bay position, selected bare-bay depth and floor height, lid travel, recessed pull, switches, vents, rear fittings, keyhole and LockDown details are reconstructed from photographs and fit, not measured manufacturer dimensions.
Extension mating geometry, hook lift and insertion clearances are unmeasured. Static geometry does not qualify installation or optical alignment.
The 91 kg instrument begins fixed on a support; moving/installing the whole instrument is outside routine sample manipulation.
